messages:
mike.build: starting image push redwood/api:2026.03.15-rc2 -> 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/api:2026.03.15-rc2
buildbot: upload succeeded for layers, creating tag...
mike.build: aws ecr put-image returned 403 Forbidden during tag create, looks like STS assume-role token expired
buildbot: retrying put-image (1/3) ... 403
mike.build: push left an untagged digest visible in registry: sha256:8c7a2d9... not associated with tag 2026.03.15-rc2
deploy-bot: Canary deploy of redwood/api:2026.03.15-rc2 failed on api-canary: image pull digest mismatch, auto-rollback to redwood/api@sha256:3a1d4f2b
alice.sre: confirming — canary rolled back to sha256:3a1d4f2b. Blocking promotion until we resolve tag health.
brian.release: we have two options: 1) re-tag orphan digest to 2026.03.15-rc2 if digest has all layers, or 2) rebuild/repush under a new tag. Thoughts?
carol.devex: re-tagging is tempting, but if STS issues persist we risk repeating partial pushes. prefer pin to stable digest and schedule controlled republish in maintenance window.
mike.build: verified that sha256:3a1d4f2b is the last good stable digest. orphan sha256:8c7a2d9 appears incomplete; some layers missing. not safe to retag.
alice.sre: action plan:
- immediate: pin manifests and k8s image refs to 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/api@sha256:3a1d4f2b
- schedule manual republish during change window after infra fixes
- annotate release notes & changelog about temp pin and provenance check
brian.release: proposed change window: today 20:00-21:00 PT to align with IAM rotation. anyone object?
carol.devex: ok for me. I'll update CHANGELOG and release docs: "2026-03-15: temporary pin to stable digest; republish planned during 20:00 PT window to restore tag 2026.03.15-rc2"
infra-bot: infra will extend assume-role TTL and patch token refresh. ETA 19:30 PT. Will post when ready.
mike.build: manual publish steps we'll run in window (avoid CI auto-retry):
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ecr-publisher --duration-seconds 3600
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=...
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...
# then
aws ecr put-image --repository-name redwood/api --image-manifest file://manifest.json --image-tag 2026.03.15-rc2
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/api --image-ids imageTag=2026.03.15-rc2 --query 'images[0].imageId.imageDigest'
```
alice.sre: I'll hold canary traffic at rolled-back digest and block promotions until we verify build metadata/provenance. add CI manifest pin: image: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/api@sha256:3a1d4f2b
brian.release: added manifest-pin PR and release note draft. tagging @alice.sre @mike.build for on-call during window.
carol.devex: also adding note about provenance: if tag 2026.03.15-rc2 shows missing digest, use pinned digest sha256:3a1d4f2b and wait for republish.
mike.build: after republish we'll verify provenance (build id, commit hash) and update release entry with verified digest and provenance URL
deploy-bot: Canary rerun scheduled post-republish. auto-promotion disabled until provenance verified.
alice.sre: thanks all, will update thread when infra patch is applied and again right before 20:00 PT :thumbsup:
